The person on the left wears a black gown with pink velvet panels and a matching hood, holding a scroll. The person on the right wears a dark blue gown with three black velvet bars on the sleeves (indicating a doctoral degree) and a hood. Both figures exhibit significant AI-generation artifacts, particularly in their lower extremities and facial features.
